2607.21187.title: Case study: proving sqrt(2) irrational with LPTP and an LLM
2607.21187.paper_summary: We present the interactions with an LLM (Large Language Model) aiming at proving that the square root of 2 is not a rational number in an LP (Logic Programming) context. We start from a few basic pure logic programming predicate definitions. We rely on the LPTP  (Logic Program Theorem Prover) system for stating and proving properties about logic programs.  As the proof language of LPTP  is based on natural deduction,  the proofs are human readable. In our case study, we sketch in LPTP the usual proof showing the irrationality of the square root of 2.  Then we describe the interactions we had with the LLM. We end up with a complete formal proof, partially generated by an LLM and fully proof-checked by LPTP.
2607.21187.paper_summary_zh: 我們展示了與 LLM（大型語言模型）的互動，旨在證明 2 的平方根不是有理數，並置於 LP（邏輯程式設計）背景中。我們從幾個基本的純邏輯程式設計謂詞定義開始。我們依賴 LPTP（邏輯程式定理證明器）系統來陳述和證明有關邏輯程式的性質。由於 LPTP 的證明語言基於自然推理，因此證明是人類可讀的。在我們的案例研究中，我們在 LPTP 中勾勒出顯示 2 的平方根不理性的通常證明。然後，我們描述了與 LLM 的互動。最後，我們得到了完整的形式證明，部分由 LLM 生成，並由 LPTP 完全檢查。
